shortDescription: Configuration for Integrated Cache content group resource.

options.name: absexpiry
options.description: Local time, up to 4 times a day, at which all objects in the content group must expire.  CLI Users: For example, to specify that the objects in the content group should expire by 11:00 PM, type the following command: add cache contentgroup <contentgroup name> -absexpiry 23:00 To specify that the objects in the content group should expire at 10:00 AM, 3 PM, 6 PM, and 11:00 PM, type: add cache contentgroup <contentgroup name> -absexpiry 10:00 15:00 18:00 23:00

options.name: absexpirygmt
options.description: Coordinated Universal Time (GMT), up to 4 times a day, when all objects in the content group must expire.

options.name: alwaysevalpolicies
options.description: Force policy evaluation for each response arriving from the origin server. Cannot be set to C(YES) if the Prefetch parameter is also set to C(YES).

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: cachecontrol
options.description: Insert a Cache-Control header into the response.

options.name: expireatlastbyte
options.description: Force expiration of the content immediately after the response is downloaded (upon receipt of the last byte of the response body). Applicable only to positive responses.

options.name: flashcache
options.description: Perform flash cache. Mutually exclusive with Poll Every Time (PET) on the same content group.

options.name: heurexpiryparam
options.description: Heuristic expiry time, in percent of the duration, since the object was last modified.

options.name: hitparams
options.description: Parameters to use for parameterized hit evaluation of an object. Up to 128 parameters can be specified. Mutually exclusive with the Hit Selector parameter.

options.name: hitselector
options.description: Selector for evaluating whether an object gets stored in a particular content group. A selector is an abstraction for a collection of PIXL expressions.

options.name: host
options.description: Flush only objects that belong to the specified host. Do not use except with parameterized invalidation. Also, the Invalidation Restricted to Host parameter for the group must be set to YES.

options.name: ignoreparamvaluecase
options.description: Ignore case when comparing parameter values during parameterized hit evaluation. (Parameter value case is ignored by default during parameterized invalidation.)

options.name: ignorereloadreq
options.description: Ignore any request to reload a cached object from the origin server. To guard against Denial of Service attacks, set this parameter to C(YES). For RFC-compliant behavior, set it to C(NO).

options.name: ignorereqcachinghdrs
options.description: Ignore Cache-Control and Pragma headers in the incoming request.

options.name: insertage
options.description: Insert an Age header into the response. An Age header contains information about the age of the object, in seconds, as calculated by the integrated cache.

options.name: insertetag
options.description: Insert an ETag header in the response. With ETag header insertion, the integrated cache does not serve full responses on repeat requests.

options.name: insertvia
options.description: Insert a Via header into the response.

options.name: invalparams
options.description: Parameters for parameterized invalidation of an object. You can specify up to 8 parameters. Mutually exclusive with invalSelector.

options.name: invalrestrictedtohost
options.description: Take the host header into account during parameterized invalidation.

options.name: invalselector
options.description: Selector for invalidating objects in the content group. A selector is an abstraction for a collection of PIXL expressions.

options.name: lazydnsresolve
options.description: Perform DNS resolution for responses only if the destination IP address in the request does not match the destination IP address of the cached response.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: matchcookies
options.description: Evaluate for parameters in the cookie header also.

options.name: maxressize
options.description: Maximum size of a response that can be cached in this content group.

options.name: memlimit
options.description: Maximum amount of memory that the cache can use. The effective limit is based on the available memory of the Citrix ADC.

options.name: minhits
options.description: Number of hits that qualifies a response for storage in this content group.

options.name: minressize
options.description: Minimum size of a response that can be cached in this content group.  Default minimum response size is 0.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the content group.  Must begin with an ASCII alphabetic or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at (@), equals (=), and hyphen (-) characters. Cannot be changed after the content group is created.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: persistha
options.description: Setting persistHA to C(YES) causes IC to save objects in contentgroup to Secondary node in HA deployment.

options.name: pinned
options.description: Do not flush objects from this content group under memory pressure.

options.name: polleverytime
options.description: Always poll for the objects in this content group. That is, retrieve the objects from the origin server whenever they are requested.

options.name: prefetch
options.description: Attempt to refresh objects that are about to go stale.

options.name: prefetchmaxpending
options.description: Maximum number of outstanding prefetches that can be queued for the content group.

options.name: prefetchperiod
options.description: Time period, in seconds before an object's calculated expiry time, during which to attempt prefetch.

options.name: prefetchperiodmillisec
options.description: Time period, in milliseconds before an object's calculated expiry time, during which to attempt prefetch.

options.name: query
options.description: Query string specifying individual objects to flush from this group by using parameterized invalidation. If this parameter is not set, all objects are flushed from the group.

options.name: quickabortsize
options.description: If the size of an object that is being downloaded is less than or equal to the quick abort value, and a client aborts during the download, the cache stops downloading the response. If the object is larger than the quick abort size, the cache continues to download the response.

options.name: relexpiry
options.description: Relative expiry time, in seconds, after which to expire an object cached in this content group.

options.name: relexpirymillisec
options.description: Relative expiry time, in milliseconds, after which to expire an object cached in this content group.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: removecookies
options.description: Remove cookies from responses.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: selectorvalue
options.description: Value of the selector to be used for flushing objects from the content group. Requires that an invalidation selector be configured for the content group.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(flushed), the resource will be flushed on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: tosecondary
options.description: content group whose objects are to be sent to secondary.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of the content group.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: weaknegrelexpiry
options.description: Relative expiry time, in seconds, for expiring negative responses. This value is used only if the expiry time cannot be determined from any other source. It is applicable only to the following status codes: 307, 403, 404, and 410.

options.name: weakposrelexpiry
options.description: Relative expiry time, in seconds, for expiring positive responses with response codes between 200 and 399. Cannot be used in combination with other Expiry attributes. Similar to -relExpiry but has lower precedence.
